integrity: The proof uses spectral projectors, an irreducible Jacobi bright sector, nonzero bright determinant, and characterization of hub cospectrality from first and second spectral moments; exact and numerical standalone checks independently corroborate the all-size proof. No independent audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Finite real-symmetric two-hub trees with two or more leaves at each hub, uniform positive hopping within each leaf group, positive inter-hub hopping, arbitrary real hub onsite potentials, and zero leaf onsite energy; not a classification of all weighted trees. All-size assertion proved analytically, with finite independent checks as corroboration. A recent source with a different advertised invariant could not be read in full; priority is not independently established.
title: A cospectral-hub criterion for quantum average-mixing rank on detuned weighted double stars
